research_metadata.coverage_notes: Humla is one of the most remote districts in Nepal with extremely limited higher education infrastructure. Tribhuvan University's affiliated community campus is the primary higher education institution operating here.

identity.name: Humla Multiple Campus
identity.short_description: Humla Multiple Campus is a community-based campus located in Simikot, Humla, affiliated with Tribhuvan University.
identity.description: Humla Multiple Campus serves as a vital center for higher education in the remote Karnali region of Nepal. Affiliated with Tribhuvan University, it offers programs primarily focused on humanities and education to cater to local students who otherwise face severe geographical challenges in accessing higher education.

recognition_details: Recognized by University Grants Commission Nepal

academics.academic_calendar: As per Tribhuvan University academic calendar

admission.guidance: Admissions open annually following the academic calendar of Tribhuvan University.
requirements: Completion of 10+2 or equivalent examination recognized by Tribhuvan University
application_process: Obtain application form from the campus administration
Submit filled form with required academic documents
admission.entrance_details: Entrance exams or merit-based selection as per TU rules.

scholarships.name: Government and UGC Scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: Needy and meritorious students, with quotas for marginalized groups
scholarships.benefits: Partial or full tuition fee waiver
scholarships.application_process: Apply through campus administration during admission period

faculty.teaching_approach: Conventional classroom teaching supplemented by local academic activities.

institutional_profile.mission: To provide accessible higher education to the students of Humla district and surrounding remote areas.
institutional_profile.vision: Empowering the remote Karnali community through quality higher education and skill development.
highlights: Only prominent higher education institution in Humla district
Affiliated with Nepal's largest university (Tribhuvan University)
why_choose_this_college: Local access to higher education without needing to migrate to regional hubs like Surkhet or Nepalgunj

student_life.campus_experience: A close-knit academic environment embedded in the unique cultural landscape of the Himalayas.

seo.meta_description: Discover Humla Multiple Campus in Simikot, Humla, offering TU-affiliated Bachelor programs in Education and Humanities.
keywords: Tribhuvan University affiliated colleges in Humla

faq.question: Where is Humla Multiple Campus located?
faq.answer: Humla Multiple Campus is located in Simikot, the headquarters of Humla district in Karnali Province, Nepal.

faq.question: Which university is Humla Multiple Campus affiliated with?
faq.answer: It is affiliated with Tribhuvan University.
